text:
I was in the area for a meeting and staying at a nearby hotel.
I had some free time, so I stopped by to consult the dentist about getting my teeth cleaned (tartar removed).
My first impression was how clean the clinic was. It's located on a main road and has parking.
I informed the staff about my social security insurance and waited in line for a short while. The air conditioning was nice and cool.

Into the room, I met a very kind and gentle dentist. I didn't feel scared or uncomfortable at all (I'm usually afraid of dentists!). After the tartar removal, the dentist checked my teeth and gave me some advice.
I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for one.
I really want to be a regular customer, but my house is far away, haha.
